summary: Iteration 7 (party_size / offline players) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass — party_size=2 → offline_count=1, total_players=2, slots_left=2; party_size=3 + 2nd user join → is_full=true; 3rd joiner → 409 'Match complet'; party_size default=1 with offline_count=0 (backward compat); bounds validation (0/5/-1 → 422); party_size=4 immediately full; list endpoint exposes offline_count/total_players/slots_left/is_full and math is consistent for seeded/legacy items. Frontend: composer shows 'Déjà réunis :' row with party-size-1/2/3 chips (default 1). Selecting 2/4 and posting created a card displaying '2/4 · 2 places' with 1 app avatar + 1 offline person pastille + 2 empty '+' slots. 'Match confirmé · 4/4' badge visible on full matches. Level filter (Tous/Débutant/Intermédiaire/Confirmé/Expert) all rendered. No deprecated Expo packages detected in server code path; only minor RN web console warnings ('shadow*' style props deprecated on web / props.pointerEvents deprecated) which are cosmetic on the web preview and don't affect native. Test Store price $79.99 not verified this iteration (expected per handoff).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking on native; visible only in web preview console.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: migrate any remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: serialize_announcement correctly derives total_players from len(players)+offline_count and computes slots_left/is_full from total; join endpoint honours offline_count in the 4-player cap (server.py:415-429).
AnnouncementCreate.party_size validated with Field(ge=1, le=4) — returns 422 on out-of-range (server.py:126).
Backward compatibility: ann.get('offline_count', 0) defaults to 0 for pre-existing seeded announcements (server.py:359).
Composer party-size chips reset to 1 after posting (club/[id].tsx:71) — good UX.
Match panel renders offline avatars between app players and empty slots as specified (club/[id].tsx:245-254).
seed_data_creation: Test announcements prefixed with TEST_iter7 created in first seeded club via marc@padel.fr. Not cleaned up (small volume, does not affect other tests).
